candidates.claim: sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/11 is an active access port in VLAN 10 (the OT VLAN), although ports 1-20 of sw-it-01 are CORP access ports in VLAN 30 and only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Move sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/11 back to access VLAN 30, or shut it down if it is not in use, after confirming the change with the engineer.

candidates.claim: The current configuration of sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/11 sets its access VLAN to 10, while the approved baseline has access VLAN 30.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change against the change record and revert the access VLAN to 30 unless the change is approved.
